'''Sarel Corro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was part of a cell led by [[Zenith]] that rescued the [[President/Legends|President]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] [[Retheus Galthe]] from [[Darth Lachris]]. Unfortunately, prolonged torture by Lachris broke Galthe's mind and a [[Balmorra citizens committee]] was assembled by Sarel Corro and other Balmorrans to oversee the transfer of political power to Tai Cordan.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarel Corro appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Balmorra.
